propositions: ChatGPT sessions in connector-limited Rebar environments lack clear guidance on safe operations, tracker access detection, and when/how to produce fallback ticket payloads instead of claiming native persistence.

The environment capability check must enumerate six dimensions (local checkout, native rebar/rebar-mcp binary, tracker worktree, network/remote access, GitHub connector, Gerrit availability) and define 'impossible native creation' precisely as: tracker-worktree unavailable AND (network/remote unavailable OR native binary unavailable).

Missing-required-field NDJSON records are silently skipped in `rebar import --dry-run` with no warning and no counter increment; malformed records are detectable only via `would_create + skipped < total_record_count` comparison.

The fallback ticket payload must conform to export.schema.json's required array (schema_version, ticket_id as agent-generated UUID4 becoming source_id on import, ticket_type, title, status: open) plus description and parent_id, enabling idempotent review and optional later ingestion via `rebar import`.
`rebar import` is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path; raw event-file injection and GitHub Contents-API writes to the tickets branch are prohibited by the append-only store invariant.

Guidance must remain discoverable from AGENTS.md, prohibit GitHub Issues as a tracker substitute, require search-before-create and append-only respect, and mandate `rebar validate`/`rebar fsck` post-import; a unit test must verify all invariants hold against the documentation.
